subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2 evidence)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jacobs <sarah.jacobs@elarahealth.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2 evidence)

Hi Sarah / Michael —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick recap + next steps from our side on deployment mode and compliance items so your security team can triage: 

Recap:
- Use case: PHI processing for appointment scheduling and clinical notes summarization.
- Primary concern: ensuring HIPAA/BAA coverage and providing SOC 2 evidence for technical controls.
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (redwood-hosted, SOC 2 + BAA available), Dedicated (reserved GPU pool, customer-isolated capacity), Private (VPC or on-prem for full network isolation).

Questions we promised to follow up on:
1) Which deployment mode do you prefer initially (Hosted with BAA, Dedicated, or Private VPC/on-prem)?
2) Specific SOC 2 scope items you need (encryption at rest/in transit, KMS/HSM, audit logs retention, change management evidence, etc.).
3) Any required data residency or additional contractual language for the BAA.

Immediate next steps (recommended):
- I attached our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a draft BAA for your legal/security review.
- If you want to proceed with Hosted + BAA, we can run a short technical onboarding and provide redacted artifacts for your auditors.
- If your security team needs private deployment, we can share a high-level architecture and timelines (Private builds typically need ~6-8 weeks for VPC/on-prem prep depending on networking).

Proposed action: schedule a 30–45 min sync next week with your security/infra leads + our Security PM (Neha) to walk through the SOC2 artifacts and agree on the deployment path.

Attachments: SOC2-report-2025.pdf, BAA-draft-Elara-2026.docx

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. A couple quick clarifying questions from my security team so we can prepare for the sync: 
1) Does the SOC2 report cover the specific control environment for the hosted offering (i.e., infrastructure run by Redwood) and is it a Type II covering the last 12 months?
2) For KMS: do you support customer-managed keys (CMK) via a customer KMS/HSM for the Private option, and what about Dedicated?
3) Audit logs — what's the default retention for admin and API logs, and can we get a feed/export for our SIEM?
4) Data residency — we need to confirm that PHI will remain in US regions if we go Hosted.

We are leaning towards Hosted + BAA to start if the SOC2 cover is comprehensive and we can get redacted artifacts. If not, we may need to evaluate Dedicated or Private.

Can we do a 30-minute call Tue or Wed (PST)? Michael will join from infra.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Security & Compliance | Elara Health
Sarah.Jacobs@elarahealth.com

Subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2 evidence)

Hi Sarah / Michael —

Thanks for the questions — answers below and a couple of concrete asks so we can make the security sync productive: 

1) SOC 2 scope: the attached SOC2-report-2025.pdf is a Type II covering controls for our hosted environment (June 2025 audit period). It covers logical access, change management, monitoring, and availability controls for the redwood-hosted offering. For Dedicated, the environment is separated at the tenant level; we provide the same control mappings plus configured network isolation.

2) KMS/HSM:
- Hosted: we encrypt customer data at rest using CMKs managed by Redwood by default; we can offer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Private (VPC/on-prem), customers can point to their KMS/HSM (we have examples for AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSM integrations).

3) Audit logs / retention / SIEM:
- Default API/admin log retention in Hosted: 90 days.
- We can export logs to a customer-managed S3/Cloud Storage bucket or push to a SIEM via our logging integration (we've done Splunk/Datadog/Elastic). For Dedicated and Private, retention policies can be configured per contract.

4) Data residency: Hosted data is stored in the region selected at onboarding (we support US regions and EU regions). For PHI you can select a US-only region and we will ensure storage and backups remain in-region.

Additional notes:
- BAA: the attached BAA-draft-Elara-2026.docx is our standard template; happy to incorporate any company-specific clauses Elara needs.
- Redacted artifacts: we can provide redacted evidence (change management tickets, patch records, SOC) ahead of the call.
- Timeline: Hosted + BAA onboarding (typical) is ~1–2 weeks for legal + onboarding. Dedicated capacity procurement and setup typically takes 3–6 weeks depending on capacity and network peering. Private VPC/on-prem builds are 6–8+ weeks.

Proposed next step: Marissa will send a calendar invite for a 30 min security sync. If you can share names/emails for any additional attendees (INFOSEC, infra, legal), we'll include them.

Doc/Links attached: SOC2-report-2025.pdf (redwood-hosted), BAA-draft-Elara-2026.docx, Security architecture PDF (link in Drive).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security PM | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
